metrics.name: Booking Payment -> Booking Created
metrics.description: Of customers who paid the booking fee, what share had a booking successfully recorded against that payment?

metrics.name: Booking Fee Refunded When Not Installed
metrics.description: Of customers who paid but weren't installed within 14 days, what share got their booking fee refunded within 16 days?

metrics.name: Address Submitted -> Booking Confirmed
metrics.description: Of customers who submitted their installation address, what share went on to confirm their booking within 24 hours?

metrics.name: Installation Setup Completed On Time
metrics.description: Of installs where the customer verified their OTP, what share had their connection plan set up within 30 minutes?

metrics.name: Device Online Right After Install
metrics.description: Of installs where the customer verified their OTP, what share had their device come online within 30 minutes?

metrics.name: Install Confirmation Sent After Rating
metrics.description: Of installs where the customer submitted a rating, what share received their install-confirmation message around the same time?

metrics.name: Technician Assignment Notification Sent
metrics.description: Of technician assignments, what share notified the customer within 10 minutes?

metrics.name: Renewal Reminder Sent On Time
metrics.description: Of plans nearing expiry, what share received a renewal reminder within 24 hours before expiry?

metrics.name: Device Back Online After Recharge
metrics.description: Of recharges, what share had the device back online within 2 hours of the new plan starting?

metrics.name: Renewal Payment -> Plan Activated
metrics.description: Of successful renewal payments, what share had the new plan and entitlement activated?

metrics.name: No Free Usage After Plan Expiry
metrics.description: Of customers whose plan expired while their connection was still live, what share used close to zero data that day?

metrics.name: Plan Hours Actually Delivered
metrics.description: Of the hours a customer paid for, what share were actually delivered with an active connection?

metrics.name: Customers With No Service Interruption
metrics.description: Of paying customers, what share had zero blocked hours in the period?

metrics.name: Wi-Fi Login Screen Opens Successfully
metrics.description: Of times a customer is prompted to sign in to Wi-Fi, what share actually saw the sign-in screen open on their device?

metrics.name: Refund Requested After Pickup
metrics.description: Of pickup tickets raised, what share had a refund request created?

metrics.name: Refund Processed After Pickup
metrics.description: Of completed pickups where the customer submitted their payment details, what share had their refund actually processed or completed?

metrics.name: Refunds Stuck 5+ Days In Processing
metrics.description: How many refunds are currently stuck in processing for 5 or more days? Shown as a count, not a percentage -- target is zero.

metrics.name: Chat Reply Sent Within 1 Minute
metrics.description: Of customer messages that are expected to get a reply, what share received one within 60 seconds?

metrics.name: New Complaint Ticket Created On Time
metrics.description: Of new complaint tickets confirmed to the customer over chat, what share were actually created in the ticketing system within 5 minutes?

metrics.name: Reopened Ticket Reflected On Time
metrics.description: Of reopened tickets confirmed to the customer over chat, what share actually showed as reopened in the ticketing system within 5 minutes?
